title: Cech local-lift representative computes the connecting boundary
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 be a short exact sequence of sheaves of O_X-modules, let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X, let s in H^0(X,C), and choose lifts t_i in B(U_i) of s|_{U_i}. Then the differences t_{i_0}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} - t_{i_1}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} are sections of A and form a Cech 1-cocycle; under the canonical homomorphism c_A from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in A to H^1(X,A), its class maps to the connecting class partial(s) in the long exact cohomology sequence.
